# group.py

[简体中文](group.zh.md) ｜ **English** ｜ [← Back to README](../../README.en.md)

GroupElement: bundle elements so they transform and animate together.

---

## Classes and methods

### `GroupElement`

Group element: bundle elements so they can be transformed or animated together.

| Method | Description |
|---|---|
| `add_element(el)` | Add an element to this group. |
| `append(el)` | Alias of add_element. |
| `remove_element(el)` | Remove an element from the group. |
| `elements()` | Return this group's immediate children, excluding grandchildren. |
| `all_elements()` | Return every descendant element, recursing into nested groups. |
| `bbox()` | Union of the bounding boxes of all children, as (min_x, min_y, max_x, max_y). |

## Full example

Run it directly in PyCharm, or from the command line: `python malight/elements/group.py`

```python
if __name__ == "__main__":
    import os

    from malight import Malight, ColorName

    _out = os.path.abspath(os.path.join(os.path.dirname(__file__),
                                        "..", "..", "output"))
    pen = Malight(os.path.join(_out, "demo_group"), width=620, height=380)
    pen.set_background_color(ColorName.WHITESMOKE)

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    # 1) Put elements in one <g> for a shared transform or effect
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    g = pen.g(id_="row")
    for i, c in enumerate([ColorName.TOMATO, ColorName.TEAL, ColorName.GOLD,
                           ColorName.STEELBLUE]):
        el = pen.circle(110 + i * 70, 100, 26, fill_color=c)
        el.change_group(g)                      # option A: create it, then move it into the group
    g.set_filter(pen.fx.shadow(5, 6, 6))        # shadow applied to the whole group
    print("children in group:", len(g.node.children))

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    # 2) Groups nest; append and add_element are equivalent
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    card = pen.g(id_="card")
    card.append(pen.rect(70, 180, 190, 110, corner_radius=14,
                         fill_color=ColorName.WHITESMOKE,
                         stroke_color=ColorName.LIGHTGRAY))
    inner = pen.g()
    inner.append(pen.text(165, 225, "nested group", font_size=20,
                          fill_color=ColorName.NAVY, h_align="middle"))
    inner.append(pen.text(165, 258, "shared rotation and opacity", font_size=13,
                          fill_color=ColorName.DIMGRAY, h_align="middle"))
    card.append(inner)                          # a group inside a group

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    # 3) Transform and opacity for the whole group
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    card.rotate(-8, cx=165, cy=235)
    card.update(opacity=0.95)

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    # 4) Group bounding box, computed by walking the children
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    print("group bbox:", tuple(round(v, 1) for v in card.bbox()))
    print("group centre:", round(card.center_x, 1), round(card.center_y, 1))

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    # 5) Take a child out by reparenting it to the canvas root (pen.canvas_node)
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    box = pen.rect(360, 60, 90, 90, fill_color=ColorName.KHAKI)
    tmp = pen.g()
    box.change_group(tmp)
    box.change_group(pen.canvas_node)           # back to the canvas root
    print("children left in the group:", len(tmp.node.children))

    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    # 6) Remove a child, or clone the whole group
    # -----------------------------------------------------------------
    g2 = pen.g()
    extra = pen.circle(430, 250, 30, fill_color=ColorName.PLUM)
    g2.append(extra)
    g2.remove_element(extra)
    clone = g.clone(dx=0, dy=170, id_="row_copy")
    print("cloned group id:", clone.node.attribs.get("id"))

    pen.finish()
```
